predbat_priority.title: Manual TOU slots on the cube while Predbat is running

confirm.title: Hand TOU control back to Predbat
confirm.description:
The EP Cube currently has user-painted time-of-use slots, and Predbat is installed on this Home Assistant instance. From v1.0 the EP Cube integration treats Predbat as the single source of truth for TOU control — any manual schedule on the cube can cause Predbat's plan to drift out of sync with what the battery is actually doing.

Selecting Submit will clear the six non-DST tier lists (workday + weekend × peak / mid-peak / off-peak) on the cube. DST tier lists, reserves and the cube's current operating mode are left untouched. Predbat keeps full control via the shim's charge / discharge / freeze services.

If you'd rather keep the manual schedule and you don't want Predbat to control the battery, the safer choice is to uninstall Predbat (or its dummy entities) instead — manual TOU painting belongs in the EP Cube mobile app.
